verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const read=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const sites={"marketplace (a closed sale)":["lib/commerce/fulfilment.ts",/emitDealCompleted\(/],"marketplace (a lost dispute)":["lib/commerce/checkout.ts",/emitDisputeLost\(/],"moderation (an upheld report)":["app/(main)/feed/report-actions.ts",/emitReportUpheld\(/],"verification (a Non Profit)":["lib/spaces/nonprofit-verification.ts",/emitOrgVerified\(/]};for(const [k,[f,re]] of Object.entries(sites)){if(!re.test(read(f)))fail("no trust signal is emitted from "+k)}const e=read("lib/trust/emitters.ts");if(!/trustSource\(/.test(e))fail("the emitters do not go through the trust source adapter");if(!/export function explainTrust/.test(read("lib/trust/explain.ts")))fail("there is no explainable read of a member trust score");const s=read("app/(main)/settings/account/standing.tsx");if(!/explainTrust\(/.test(s)||!/readOwnTrustSignals\(/.test(s))fail("a member cannot see their own standing explained");if(!/recomputeAllTrustScores\(/.test(read("app/api/cron/refresh-traits/route.ts")))fail("no job recomputes trust scores");console.log("ok")'

append.detail: Trust emitters (lib/trust/emitters.ts): a closed sale credits each seller, a lost dispute and an upheld report or suspension are penalties, a verified Non Profit credits its submitter; each keyed once per record and best-effort. The explainable read is app code, not an RPC: readOwnTrustSignals is called only with the signed-in member's own id, and explainTrust gives one line per signal kind under Settings, Account and privacy. The nightly refresh-traits cron replays the ledger with the current weights (recomputeAllTrustScores). No migration.
